mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which can stimulate economic activity and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are not higher than average during periods of declining FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate suggests labor market strength, which may boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops below 5% but 20-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts and payroll employment together indicate strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and PAYEMS increase but 60-day returns are not positively correlated.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in industrial production signals increased economic output, which can lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth is positive but 20-day returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP indicates economic expansion, which should lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases but 60-day returns are not higher than average.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index above 2.5% may indicate inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% but 20-day returns remain positive more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is low and payroll employment is high, it indicates a strong labor market, which should lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE is low and PAYEMS is high but 60-day returns are not positively correlated.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the real savings rate indicates increased consumer spending, which can boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases but 20-day returns are not higher than average.
